master-ozriel-1.review: Mint backdrop and enclosed hydraulic-arm/cable openings only; preserve crimson heart, ivory shields and dark mechanical shading.

master-ozriel-2.review: Muted green backdrop through radial engine spokes and rotor gaps; retain ivory vanes, crimson spikes and black gearwork.

master-ozriel-3.review: Light green exterior only; no enclosed background openings. Preserve all ivory piston housings, silver gears and five crimson reactors.

master-ilvaris-1.review: Turquoise exterior and narrow casing/cable openings. Preserve magenta-crimson impellers, white enamel and dark inner machinery.

master-ilvaris-2.review: Mint exterior and explicit impeller/rotor openings; preserve ivory and crimson blades, fine black cables and lower connected machinery.

master-ilvaris-3.review: Turquoise backdrop plus flat blue-green backdrop shadow and cable openings; local empty-backdrop rectangle removes generated lettering beside the lower-right blade. Preserve white blade armor, violet-black gears, crimson cables and mechanical contact shading.

master-kaelith-1.review: Muted green exterior and two upper cable openings only. Tight threshold protects pale green-gray reflections on ivory crescent blades and metal gear hubs; never seed those subject facets.

master-kaelith-2.review: Green exterior and enclosed upper chain opening; preserve crimson shards, white prismatic armor, wheel spokes, chain links and dark mechanical shading.

master-kaelith-3.review: Mint exterior and enclosed crescent/rotor gaps; preserve black eclipse disk, violet housings and all attached or detached crimson shards.
